_comment: Hand-written. One entry per anchor in removed-commands.json; gen-cli-data.mjs fails when an anchor has no path. Value is Markdown.

paths.replay: `smthrs runs replay <run>` reads committed execution history without re-executing actions.
paths.rewind: `smthrs runs rewind <run> --at <sequence> --preview`, then `--yes` to restore an eligible historical frame.
paths.fork: `smthrs runs fork <run> --at <sequence>` creates a resumable child with an isolated workspace.
paths.worktrees: `smthrs runs fork` retains an isolated workspace under `.flows/forks/`; separate worktree list/prune commands are not exposed.
paths.hijack: control a live run with `smthrs runs steer`, `smthrs runs signal`, `smthrs approvals approve`, `smthrs approvals deny`, or `smthrs runs cancel`, and resume a parked one with `smthrs runs resume`; see [Steering runs](/docs/guides/steering/).
paths.pause: `smthrs runs cancel` ends a run and `smthrs runs resume` resumes a parked one; see [Steering runs](/docs/guides/steering/).
paths.gateway: bare `smthrs gateway` survives as an alias of `smthrs serve`, which hosts the control server for the project; see [Control plane](/docs/guides/control-plane/).
paths.ui: `smthrs serve` hosts the control server; see [Control plane](/docs/guides/control-plane/).
paths.gui: `smthrs serve` hosts the control server; see [Control plane](/docs/guides/control-plane/).
paths.monitor: `smthrs serve` hosts the control server; see [Control plane](/docs/guides/control-plane/).
paths.supervise: recovery is owned by the run driver; watch runs with `smthrs runs list` and `smthrs runs show`; see [Inspecting runs](/docs/guides/inspecting-runs/).
paths.supervisor: recovery is owned by the run driver; watch runs with `smthrs runs list` and `smthrs runs show`; see [Inspecting runs](/docs/guides/inspecting-runs/).
paths.top: recovery is owned by the run driver; watch runs with `smthrs runs list` and `smthrs runs show`; see [Inspecting runs](/docs/guides/inspecting-runs/).
paths.supervision: `smthrs runs resume` resumes a parked run, and the run driver owns takeover and recovery; see [Inspecting runs](/docs/guides/inspecting-runs/).
paths.eval: `smthrs eval list|run|baseline|compare` operates fixed evaluation suites.
paths.scores: use `smthrs eval run|compare` for fixed-suite scores and baseline regressions.
paths.chat: author the flow as `flows/<name>/flow.mdx` or `flows/<name>/flow.ts` and run it with `smthrs flow start`; see [Markdown flows](/docs/guides/markdown-flows/) and [Module flows](/docs/guides/module-flows/).
paths.chat-create: author the flow as `flows/<name>/flow.mdx` or `flows/<name>/flow.ts` and run it with `smthrs flow start`; see [Markdown flows](/docs/guides/markdown-flows/) and [Module flows](/docs/guides/module-flows/).
paths.what: author the flow as `flows/<name>/flow.mdx` or `flows/<name>/flow.ts` and run it with `smthrs flow start`; see [Markdown flows](/docs/guides/markdown-flows/) and [Module flows](/docs/guides/module-flows/).
paths.ask: author the flow as `flows/<name>/flow.mdx` or `flows/<name>/flow.ts` and run it with `smthrs flow start`; see [Markdown flows](/docs/guides/markdown-flows/) and [Module flows](/docs/guides/module-flows/).
paths.agents: seats resolve from provider environment keys, and `smthrs doctor` reports provider readiness; see [Model seats](/docs/guides/model-seats/) and [Environment variables](/docs/reference/environment-variables/).
paths.observability: the kernel's telemetry and the OTLP layer; see [Observability](/docs/guides/observability/).
paths.cron: `smthrs triggers register|list|show|enable|disable|fire|serve`; schedules run while `smthrs serve` or `smthrs triggers serve` is active.
paths.share: no replacement ships in rc.0; flows live in the project's own `flows/` directory and move with its version control.
paths.add: no replacement ships in rc.0; flows live in the project's own `flows/` directory.
paths.remove: no replacement ships in rc.0; flows live in the project's own `flows/` directory.
paths.eject: no replacement ships in rc.0; a migrated project already owns every file under `flows/`.
paths.upgrade: `smthrs migrate`; see Plan and apply above.
paths.packs: no replacement ships in rc.0; a 1.0 project keeps flows under `flows/` in version control; see [Project layout](/docs/reference/project-layout/).
paths.workflow: bare `smthrs workflow` is removed too, and `smthrs workflow list` survives as a hidden alias. `smthrs flow list` lists flows, `smthrs flow start` runs one, and `smthrs doctor` checks readiness; see [Flow discovery](/docs/guides/flow-discovery/).
paths.human: list parked approvals with `smthrs runs list --status waiting-approval`, then answer them with `smthrs approvals approve` or `smthrs approvals deny`; see [Human approval](/docs/tutorials/human-approval/).
paths.ask-human: the run parks at the approval; list parked approvals with `smthrs runs list --status waiting-approval`, then answer them with `smthrs approvals approve` or `smthrs approvals deny`; see [Human approval](/docs/tutorials/human-approval/).
paths.node: `smthrs runs output` prints one registered node output and `smthrs runs logs --format json` renders the events; see [Inspecting runs](/docs/guides/inspecting-runs/).
paths.tail: `smthrs runs logs --follow` streams future events and `smthrs runs output` prints one registered node output; see [Inspecting runs](/docs/guides/inspecting-runs/).
paths.test: run the project's own test runner; for testing flows themselves, see [Testing flows](/docs/guides/testing-flows/).
paths.databases: local SQLite, or PostgreSQL with `SMITHERS_POSTGRES_URL` or `DATABASE_URL`. Any other `SMITHERS_BACKEND`, such as `pglite`, exits 1 with `unsupported_database`. See [Unsupported database](/docs/troubleshooting/unsupported-database/).
paths.init: the `smthrs init` verb itself stays; seats resolve from provider environment keys; see [Model seats](/docs/guides/model-seats/) and [Environment variables](/docs/reference/environment-variables/).
paths.plan-admission: declare parallelism in the flow and let plan admission bound it; see [Flows, actions, and plans](/docs/concepts/flows-actions-plans/) and [Plan, approve, run](/docs/guides/plan-approve-run/).
paths.flows: This anchor is not a removal. Verbs that take a flow id refuse the reserved `system/*` ids: a reserved system flow id carries no body in 1.0.0-rc.0, so a launch would park with nothing to run. **1.0 path:** name a flow from `smthrs flow list`; see [Flow discovery](/docs/guides/flow-discovery/).
